GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.9 (27 Oct 45) ESS-IN
(SCAPIN - 196)
27 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Nishina Laboratory, Institute of Physical and Chemical Research
1. Reference is made to memorandum from this office, AG 000.9 (17 Oct 45) ESS, subject as above, dated 17 October 1945, in which you were authorized to permit Dr. Nishina to operate his cyclotron under specified conditions.
2. The authorization granted under the above memorandum is hereby limited to permit Dr. Nishina to conduct investigations of radio-active substances and neutrons only in the fields of biology and medicine and not in the fields of chemistry and metallurgy.
3. Other conditions stated in the above memorandum of 17 October 1945 will still apply.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
